summary: Seed the env-derived account scope into the true-global parameter bucket, and resolve the account automatically when none is configured.
reason: Unipile requires account_id on path-scoped dependents such as /users/{id}/posts, but the generated env default only reached flat-list requests. account_id is also an opaque 22-character id required on 52 of 94 endpoints, so a sync with only an API key failed on eight resources.
validated_outcome: sync now succeeds with only UNIPILE_API_KEY set, adopting the single connected account and refusing ambiguously when several exist.
